name: 005_session_open_break_tf1
hypothesis: The London and New York opens are when the day's concentrated flow arrives: desks that must trade the session open cross the spread, and the overnight range is the agreed reference price they cross. A break of the pre-session range with genuine volume is therefore filled by real flow instead of by an opposing taker, unlike a mid-session breakout. The post-only entry is part of the hypothesis, not a saving: at the range edge we can rest a limit and pay maker instead of taker, which is worth 0.03% of price on this idea's wider stop. [Timeframe variant of 005_session_open_break, 15m -> 1m, mode chart: same bar counts and ATR multiples, hold x0.0666667, pct stop x0.258.]
